images.title: Quick checks for 8560
images.purpose: Show the numbers from 2 to 10 that divide 8560 without long division.
images.composition: The number 8560 large and centred, with one evenly spaced row of 5 round chips well below it.
images.exact_structure: Top, centred: the number 8560 in large type. Below it, one row of 5 equal teal #0072B2 circles evenly spaced, each holding one label. Exactly 5 circles, nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any circle holding a number other than 2, 4, 5, 8, 10
images.description: The number 8560 above five circles marked 2, 4, 5, 8 and 10.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say each circle number and how they could tell it divides 8560.

image_decisions.why: One number with its five divisors is a clean picture idea.
